endpoints.name: AgentWork — Web evidence for agents
endpoints.description: Fetch URL — compact fetch of a public webpage: final URL, HTTP status, content type, title, clean text and text_sha256 (no link or heading lists). Same engine and prices as web/read: $0.005 per URL Base ($0.01 Algorand); batch of 2-10 urls $0.003/URL; render=true $0.01/URL. robots.txt respected. Failed fetches not settled.

endpoints.name: AgentWork — Web evidence for agents
endpoints.description: Website change monitoring / webpage change detection — text_sha256 or previous_text diff for documentation, pricing-page, changelog and policy monitoring. Batch up to 10 URLs in one call (items[]); optional CSS selector scoping and a one-line diff summary. $0.005 per URL Base ($0.01 Algorand); batch of 2-10 $0.003/URL ($0.006). Caller stores baseline; no server watch list. HTML/text only; no JS render. Failed checks not settled.

endpoints.name: AgentWork — Web evidence for agents
endpoints.description: PDF text extraction / PDF to text — extract text from a public digital PDF into page-numbered JSON for RAG (no OCR). $0.01 USDC Base or Algorand. Caps 20 pages / 5 MiB / 100k chars; source + text SHA-256. No passwords or table reconstruction. Failed extractions not settled.

endpoints.name: AgentWork — Web evidence for agents
endpoints.description: Web read / fetch URL / scrape URL to markdown — public webpage to clean text or Markdown with headings, links and SHA-256, for RAG and research. Batch up to 10 URLs; optional JavaScript rendering (headless Chromium). $0.005 per URL Base ($0.01 Algorand); batch of 2-10 $0.003/URL ($0.006); render $0.01/URL ($0.02). Synchronous JSON, no account; respects robots.txt; no paywall bypass. Failed reads not settled.

endpoints.name: AgentWork — Web evidence for agents
endpoints.description: Scrape URL to markdown — public webpage to clean Markdown (headings, lists, links, tables, code) plus text and SHA-256, for RAG and LLM context. Same engine and prices as web/read with format=markdown by default: $0.005 per URL Base ($0.01 Algorand); batch of 2-10 urls $0.003/URL; render=true for JavaScript pages $0.01/URL. Failed reads not settled.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup
endpoints.description: What a transaction on Base costs right now, in dollars, including the L1 data fee most gas trackers leave out. Read from real receipts in the latest Base blocks: the median a plain ETH transfer, a USDC transfer and a Uniswap swap actually paid (L2 fee + L1 fee), what the same gas costs at the current base fee and median tip, and the tip spread over 20 blocks. endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup
endpoints.description: What did this transaction do? Pass ?chain=base|arc&tx=0x... and get one plain sentence plus the parts: who called which function (named from a table of common ones), every token and NFT that moved and between whom, native value, success or failure, and the gas paid in ETH and dollars on Base (ETH priced from the Uniswap v3 pool on chain) or in USDC on Arc, including native USDC that only appears as a log.

endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup
endpoints.description: What can the people behind this contract do to holders? Pass ?chain=base|arc&address=0x... and we read its bytecode on chain (and the code behind a proxy): mint, pause, blacklist, change fees or taxes, cap wallets, switch trading off, upgrade the code. Plus proxy type, who owns it now (renounced or a live wallet or contract) and basic token data. Facts about what the code allows, not a forecast.

endpoints.description: Which x402 sellers have buyers who come back? endpoints.name: APEX Faucet — Free APEX and USDC, three times a day · No Gas, No Signup

endpoints.description: A marketplace where AI agents discover and pay each other per call in USDC over x402 — settlement goes DIRECTLY to the seller, non-custodial, no accounts and no API keys. POST /s/{id} invokes any listed MCP service at that seller's own price; GET /v1/marketplace/services is the catalog. Also first-party: free token prices, on-chain Base reads (gas, blocks, ETH/USDC balances, tx status, token metadata), token-safety and address-risk screening, and a non-custodial USDC on/off-ramp (x402 + a licensed payment partner). COMPLIANCE (binding, ramp only): 18+ only; served worldwide via our licensed provider across ~160 countries (EUR/SEPA in the EU/EEA incl. Portugal, card elsewhere; NOT the UK, US persons, or sanctioned countries); own-account rule — the sending wallet and the receiving bank account must belong to the same person (the agent's owner), no third-party funds, no aggregation, no P2P transfers. Crypto is volatile; quotes indicative; nothing here is investment advice. RETRIES: GET endpoints are idempotent — repeat freely. Session POSTs are NOT idempotent (each success creates a new order and costs the x402 fee), but any non-2xx means nothing was created or charged, and an unanswered request at worst leaves an unused checkout link that expires in ~2 hours — no funds move until the human owner completes checkout. Pass the same customerId on retries and check /v1/customers/{customerId}/orders for duplicates. On 429, sleep Retry-After seconds.

Returns ok, HTTP status, latency_ms, redirects, final_url, tls, server and content-type headers; a timeout or refused connection is answered as ok:false. One check, not monitoring history. $0.003 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need callable agent services for a capability across protocols: x402 listings ranked by relevance weighted by 30-day paying wallets, plus hosted MCP servers from the Official MCP Registry (a capped subset, count in coverage; those naming x402, L402, MPP or pay-per-call first; that registry publishes no prices). L402 and MPP listings are not covered. ?q= required. $0.002 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need to know whether x402 buyers come back: repeat-payer rate per service with the 24-hour rule (first and last payment at least 24 h apart), same-session retries collapsed, scheduled single-wallet loops flagged and excluded, week-1/4/12 cohorts, median payments per payer and top-wallet share, from on-chain USDC transfers to listed payTo addresses up to $1, coverage stated. $0.002 USDC per call.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need one agent-economy protocol in detail: every normalised row (per chain or rail, all-time and 30-day windows) for x402, Tempo MPP, Virtuals ACP, Olas, Masumi, ERC-8004, Solana agent registries, Base agent contracts or MCP, each with unit, window, source URL and fetch time. Optional ?protocol=. L402 is not covered. $0.002 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need the agent economy beyond x402 in one call: per protocol (x402, Tempo MPP, Virtuals ACP, Olas, Masumi, ERC-8004 and Solana agent registries, Base agent contracts, MCP registry) the headline services, payments, payers and USD volume with unit, window, source and date. Units differ, so totals are never summed. L402 is not covered. $0.003 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need a weather forecast for a latitude/longitude anywhere in the world: hourly temperature, wind speed and direction, humidity, pressure, cloud cover, precipitation and weather symbol for the next 1-240 hours from MET Norway, plus active official NWS alerts (event, severity, headline) for points in the United States. CC BY 4.0 attribution in every reply. $0.001 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need a US public company's SEC EDGAR filings and key financials by ticker or CIK: latest filings (form, filing and report dates, accession, primary document URL; filter by form such as 10-K,10-Q,8-K) plus latest reported XBRL facts: revenue, net income, diluted EPS, total assets, equity and shares outstanding, each with period, form and filing date (null when the company does not report that fact in XBRL). Data as filed. $0.002 USDC per call. Or pay by stablecoin transfer: see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need the current UTC time from a server clock, the local time, UTC offset and DST flag in up to 10 IANA time zones (tz=Europe/Berlin,Asia/Tokyo), or to convert a time between zones (at=2026-10-05T09:00&tz=America/New_York&to=Asia/Kolkata), with DST gaps and overlaps flagged. $0.001 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need one report on a domain: DNS records (A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CAA) with SPF and DMARC parsed, RDAP registration for .com, .net and .org (registrar, dates, status, nameservers, DNSSEC), and the homepage's HTTPS security headers (HSTS, CSP...) with HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect and rule-based findings. Sections not answered are marked. $0.002 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for a DEX swap quote with a ready unsigned transaction: best route from Velora (ParaSwap) with KyberSwap as fallback on Base, Arbitrum, Ethereum, Optimism, Polygon and BNB Chain. Give chain, from, to (symbol like USDC/WETH/ETH or token address), amount in base units and taker (your wallet). Returns expected output, calldata, approval target and gas estimate; you sign and broadcast, P0 never touches funds. endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you must confirm that a transaction paid at least an amount of an asset to an address: pass tx, to, amount (in asset units, e.g. 0.01) and asset (USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, WBTC, cbBTC, ETH or POL) on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum or Polygon; chain is optional for EVM. Returns verified true/false with reason, paid amount, sender, confirmations and block time. An observation, not escrow. $0.003 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for reading a web page as clean markdown for an LLM or agent (url to markdown, reader, html to text): POST {url, max_chars} and get {title, markdown, chars, source_url}. One fetch of a public http/https page on your request, robots.txt respected, 2 MB and 8 s caps; scripts and styles stripped; headings, links, lists, code and tables kept; up to 20,000 chars. Rule-based, no AI summary. $0.005 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need a wallet's token balances on several chains in one call: native coin plus USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, WBTC/cbBTC on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum and Polygon. Pass address (0x or an ENS name like vitalik.eth, resolved on Ethereum) and optional chains. Exact on-chain amounts with block numbers; a chain that fails is listed in errors, never shown as zero. No USD prices. $0.002 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Highest-demand x402 services tagged 'clock': ranked by 30-day unique paying wallets, with calls, price, network and calls-per-payer for each. 12 providers and 204 paying wallets measured in this tag.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need cross-service demand in x402: how many paying wallets paid two or more services in the same 30-day window, the distribution, and the service pairs sharing the most wallets, from on-chain USDC transfers to listed payTo addresses up to $1, coverage stated. $0.002 USDC per call.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need where x402 money actually goes, not just where listings are: estimated 30-day spend (listed price x paid calls) and spend share per chain and per tag next to listing share, the average price per paid call and the spend-weighted median price, API-call spend separated from goods purchases, plus on-chain USDC transfers to listed payTo addresses per chain, split into API-sized (up to $1) and larger transfers. Calls are labelled as paid outcomes. $0.002 USDC per call.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need demand concentration in the x402 Bazaar: for each tag, the share of its 30-day paying wallets held by the top-1 and top-3 services and by the top seller, HHI, zero-payer services, and summed payers stated as an upper bound. Optional ?tag= for one tag. $0.002 USDC per call.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you sell an x402 API and want to know how your x402 Bazaar listing ranks or when it may drop out: rank in its tag by 30-day unique payers, payers, calls, price percentile, last call and estimated 30-day expiry date, metadata flags (no icon, no output schema, no service name, no tags, description over 500 chars) and the tag leaders. Pass ?url=<resource URL>. $0.001 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for debugging an x402 client: pay $0.001 in USDC (or USDT0 on Arbitrum) on any network in accepts and get back what the server received: the decoded payment payload (scheme, network, authorization fields, signature), checks of amount, payTo, asset and validity window against this route's requirement, and the facilitator's settlement result. Only the payment header is echoed, never other headers.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for a short euro exchange rate history: daily ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates of one currency against EUR for up to the last 30 days (ccy=USD, days=1..30), with min, max and percent change over the window and a stale flag. Source attribution in every reply. Reference rates for information only, not transaction rates. $0.002 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use when you need what changed in the x402 Bazaar: new listings, dropped (no longer listed) routes, top movers by 30-day unique payers, trending tags, and deltas of catalog totals (resources, sellers, calls, payers) vs our snapshot nearest 24 h and 7 days earlier, with the real gap in hours. Built from snapshots of the public Coinbase CDP x402 Bazaar catalog, with as_of and a stale flag. $0.002 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.name: P0 Agent Economy Index
endpoints.description: Use for euro exchange rates: the latest ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates (EUR base, about 30 currencies such as USD, GBP, JPY, CHF, PLN), the publication date, percent change versus the previous ECB publication and a stale flag. Source attribution in every reply. Reference rates for information only, not transaction rates. $0.001 USDC per call. Or pay directly in BTC, ETH, USDT, SOL, TRX or STX (sub-cent: stablecoins): see /pay.

endpoints.description: Describe finite observations with count, sum, min, max, mean, median and population standard deviation.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI

endpoints.description: Compute exact n choose k for 0<=k<=n<=1000; return a decimal string.

endpoints.description: Compute exact Fibonacci F(n), with F(0)=0 and F(1)=1, for n<=1000.

endpoints.description: Calculate percentage change relative to a nonzero starting value using the signed denominator.

endpoints.description: Calculate a percentage of a number: value * percent / 100.

endpoints.description: Extract one field from each record; reports missing fields as null.

endpoints.description: Split a JSON array into consecutive chunks without changing element order.

endpoints.description: Rename one top-level object key; refuses to overwrite an existing different key.

endpoints.description: Stable-sort scalar array values or one scalar field. Refuses mixed value types and non-scalar sort keys.

endpoints.description: Remove duplicate JSON values using sorted-key structural equality, preserving first occurrences.

endpoints.description: Recursively merge two JSON objects; the right operand wins conflicts and replaces arrays.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Pick selected top-level object keys; absent keys are omitted.

endpoints.description: Read an RFC 6901 pointer from a JSON value without executing expressions.

endpoints.name: SignalDesk AI
endpoints.description: Build nested JSON objects from RFC 6901 leaf pointers; numeric segments stay object keys, not arrays. Reject conflicting paths.

endpoints.description: Recursively sort object keys while preserving array order. Not cryptographic RFC 8785 canonicalisation.

endpoints.description: Validate JSON syntax only, not a user-provided schema.

endpoints.name: x402 multi-tool API
endpoints.description: Email and domain trust check. Give an email address or a domain, get one risk level (low, medium, high) with plain-language flags and the facts behind them: domain age, registrar, expiry and hold status (RDAP); MX, SPF and DMARC policy; the live TLS certificate; and for emails, syntax, disposable-provider and role-address checks. Judges the domain: does not verify that the mailbox exists and does not check DKIM.

endpoints.name: x402 multi-tool API
endpoints.description: Insurance location risk score for a US street address or lat/lon. One 0-100 natural hazard score plus a score, tier and underlying factors for each of four perils: flood (FEMA flood zone), earthquake (USGS ASCE 7-22), wildfire (USFS Wildfire Risk to Communities, California and Utah state hazard zones) and hail (NOAA storm reports within 10 miles over 20 years). For property underwriting and real estate due diligence.

endpoints.name: x402 multi-tool API
endpoints.description: Hail, damaging wind and tornado history for a US street address or lat/lon. Every NOAA Storm Prediction Center storm report within a radius (1-50 miles, default 10) over a lookback window (default 20 years, back to 1955): counts, hail days, largest hail, strongest wind, tornado ratings and track distance, a year-by-year table, and each event with distance and direction.

endpoints.name: x402 multi-tool API
endpoints.description: Wildfire risk report by street address or lat/lon. USFS Wildfire Risk to Communities values for the point (annual burn probability, risk to structures, exposure type, flame length, hazard potential class) plus the state-designated hazard zone where one exists: California Fire Hazard Severity Zones (SRA and LRA) and Utah High Risk WUI.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Annual time series of one World Bank indicator for a country, with latest value, prior year, and change. Indicators: gdp, gdp-growth, gdp-per-capita, inflation, unemployment, population, govt-debt, current-account, exports, fdi. Pick the country with `?country=US` (ISO2/ISO3, default US) and the span with `?limit=` years (default 10). Cross-country macro reference. Source: World Bank (CC BY 4.0).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: A country's macro profile in one call: latest GDP, GDP growth, GDP per capita, inflation, unemployment, population, government debt, current account, exports, and FDI, from the World Bank's World Development Indicators. Pass an ISO country code in the path (e.g. US, CN, IN, DE). International macro the US-only FRED/BLS endpoints don't cover. Source: World Bank (CC BY 4.0). From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: What tickers 4chan's finance board (/biz/) is buzzing about most over the last 24h, ranked by mention volume. Each ticker carries its mention count and 24h change in rank and mentions (4chan has no upvotes, so upvotes is always 0). No ticker needed; ?page= to paginate (100 per page). A raw read of /biz/ chatter, separate from the Reddit feed. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: What stocks and crypto Reddit is talking about most over the last 24h, by mention volume across the busiest Reddit money subreddits (r/wallstreetbets, r/stocks, r/CryptoCurrency, r/Bitcoin, etc.). Each ticker carries mentions, upvotes, and 24h change in rank and mentions; covered subreddits are listed per response. ?filter=stocks|crypto|all (default all), ?page=. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Snapshot a list of US-listed tickers at once: for each symbol, the company name, market session, current price, day change and percent change, day OHLCV with VWAP, and previous close. Pass a comma-separated list via `?tickers=AAPL,MSFT,NVDA` (up to 250). Built for pricing a watchlist or portfolio in a single request. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Use for one call answering 'where is retail attention right now': a deterministic 0–100 attention score per ticker blending Reddit finance-community and 4chan /biz/ mention shares (24h window), with momentum, cross-platform confirmation, breadth & concentration (HHI), and Fear & Greed context. Transparent — every row carries its raw per-platform inputs. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Reference list of security type codes used in ticker reference data (e.g. CS = Common Stock, ETF, PFD, WARRANT) with descriptions. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API for AI agents. No API key or account; pay in USDC via x402.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Company name, exchange, market cap, share class, SIC code, address, and other reference fields for a US-listed ticker. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API for AI agents. No API key or account; pay in USDC via x402.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The daily US Treasury par yield curve (Constant Maturity Treasury rates) for every maturity from 1 month to 30 years, in percent. Defaults to the latest published day; pass `?limit=` for more recent days (max 250) and `?year=YYYY`. No ticker needed. Use for the risk-free rate, rate-sensitivity context, and yield-curve inversion in macro-aware analysis. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Use for a quick momentum or trend read on a US-listed stock. Returns the latest RSI (14) with overbought, oversold, or neutral zone, SMA 50 and EMA 20 with price position, and MACD with signal cross state, alongside the current delayed price. Factual indicator readings, not buy or sell guidance. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Find tickers by free-text `?search=` (name or symbol) across asset classes via `?market=stocks|crypto|fx|indices` (default stocks), with optional `?type=`, `?exchange=`, `?active=`, `?limit=`. Returns symbol, name, market, exchange, type, and identifiers. Use to discover crypto pairs (X:BTCUSD), FX pairs (C:EURUSD), and index symbols (I:SPX). From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The short-squeeze picture for a US stock in one call: bi-weekly short interest with days-to-cover, daily short-sale volume with short-volume ratio, and settlement fails-to-deliver, plus a computed signal pulling the headline gauges together. Replaces three separate calls (short-interest + short-volume + fails-to-deliver) at a lower combined price. Sections degrade independently. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Live on-chain spot market for one Hyperliquid-listed token by symbol (e.g. HYPE, PURR) or @index: mid/mark price, previous-day price, 24h USD and base volume, circulating and total supply, and market cap, quoted in USDC. Spot, not a perp — for funding/open interest use /api/v1/perps/{coin}; for major-coin fiat prices use /api/v1/crypto. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Level-2 order book for one Hyperliquid spot market: aggregated bid and ask price levels, each with size and resting order count, as of the book timestamp. Pass a token symbol (e.g. HYPE, PURR) or @index. Use to gauge spot liquidity, spread, and depth. Spot book — for the perp book use /api/v1/perps/orderbook/{coin}. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Historical stock splits for a ticker, with execution date and split ratio (split_from to split_to). Most recent first. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API for AI agents. No API key or account; pay in USDC via x402.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Historical OHLCV candles for one Hyperliquid spot market at the requested interval (1m, 5m, 15m, 1h, 4h, 1d, 1w) over a time window. Pass a token symbol (e.g. HYPE, PURR) or @index and tune with `?interval=` (default 1h), `?lookback=` candles (default 200, max 5000), or `?start=`/`?end=` epoch-ms. Spot candles — for perp candles use /api/v1/perps/candles/{coin}. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: On-chain facts for any Solana SPL token, read straight from the public ledger (not the Jupiter API): total supply and decimals, mint and freeze authority, initialization, and token program (SPL Token or Token-2022). Pass a base58 mint address or a known symbol (SOL, JUP, JLP, USDC, USDT, BONK, JTO, WIF). Keyless public-chain data, no account. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Market-wide split calendar across all US tickers (no ticker needed). Each row has the ticker, execution date, direction (`forward`/`reverse`), split_from/split_to, numeric `ratio`, and a human `ratio_text` like `10:1` or `1:8`. Future-dated announced splits sort first. Filter `?type=forward|reverse|all`, `?from=`/`?to=` date window, `?order=`, `?limit=`. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Live on-chain spot prices for every token on the Hyperliquid DEX (HYPE, PURR, and hundreds more), quoted in USDC: mid/mark price, previous-day price, 24h USD and base volume, circulating and total supply, and market cap — sorted by 24h volume. Spot, not derivatives: for funding/open interest use /api/v1/perps; for major-coin fiat prices use /api/v1/crypto. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Jupiter's JLP liquidity pool, decoded from the Perpetuals program's on-chain accounts (not the Jupiter API): AUM (USD), JLP supply and virtual price (AUM ÷ supply), pool-wide long/short trader exposure, and each asset (SOL, ETH, WBTC, USDC, USDT) with holdings, owned/locked, utilization %, and long/short USD. Keyless public-chain data, no Jupiter API. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Single-call snapshot of a ticker's current state: last quote, last trade, today's OHLC + volume + VWAP, previous-day OHLC, today's change vs previous close. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API for AI agents. No API key or account; pay in USDC via x402.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The exchange-reported short-interest history for a US-listed stock: total shares sold short, average daily volume, and days-to-cover for each bi-weekly FINRA settlement date, most recent first. A core short-squeeze and bearish-positioning signal. Tune how many settlements to return with `?limit=` (default 12). From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Daily short-sale volume for a US-listed stock: total volume, short volume, exempt and non-exempt short volume, the short-volume ratio, and a per-venue breakdown (NYSE, Nasdaq, ADF), most recent day first. A higher-frequency read on shorting pressure than bi-weekly short interest. Tune with `?limit=` (default 20). From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The native SOL balance and basic account state for any Solana address, read from the public ledger: lamports and SOL, whether the account exists, its owning program, executable flag, and data size. Pass a base58 address in the path. Keyless on-chain data — no Jupiter API, no account. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API. Pay per request in USDC via x402, no API key.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The largest holders of any Solana SPL token (top accounts by balance, up to 20), each with its token account, owner wallet, balance, and share of total supply — for holder-concentration and whale analysis. Pass a base58 mint or a known symbol (JUP, JLP, …); tune with `?limit=` (max 20). Read from the public ledger, no Jupiter API. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Describe a screen in plain English via `?q=` (e.g. 'oversold large caps up today on high volume'). An LLM parses it into a filter, screens the entire US market, optionally confirms oversold/overbought with RSI, and returns a ranked shortlist with a one-line rationale per name. No need to know the filter schema or run the enrichment loop yourself. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: A transparent 0–100 short-squeeze pressure score for a US stock. Combines short interest as a % of shares, days-to-cover, the daily short-volume ratio, fails-to-deliver vs average volume, and a price/social spark into one gauge — with the full sub-factor breakdown and the raw inputs it scored. Factual quantitative reading, not advice. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: A full AI-synthesized equity-research memo for one US stock in one call. Fans out across profile, fundamentals, technicals, short interest, insider activity (Form 4/144), 13D/G stakes, 8-K events, news and sentiment, then an LLM distils a balanced bull/bear case, valuation context, catalysts, risks and a per-signal read-out with an overall stance. Factual synthesis, not advice. From x402stock

endpoints.description: The effective federal funds rate — the Fed's benchmark policy rate that anchors every other US interest rate — as a monthly average in percent, with the latest value, prior month, month-over-month and year-over-year change, and recent history. No ticker needed. The rate every rate-sensitive analysis starts from. Sourced from the St. Louis Fed (FRED). From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The combined market regime — one read fusing the stock Fear & Greed score and velocity, VIX, insider-buying sentiment, and net liquidity into a named regime (e.g. Mixed Signals) with severity and a suggested stance, plus how the S&P 500 historically performed after similar regimes (forward 5/22-day and 1/3-month returns and win rates). From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The full daily history of the US stock Fear & Greed index from 2016 to today, each point a date and 0–100 score. Pass `?days=N` to return only the most recent N days (default: full series). Use for charting sentiment regimes and backtesting against price. Companion to /api/v1/fear-greed (current reading). From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: US net liquidity (Fed balance sheet minus Treasury General Account minus reverse repo) as a 0–100 percentile with its label and 4-week trend, broken into its FRED components (WALCL, TGA, RRP, M2) plus ~52 weeks of history. A macro-liquidity gauge for risk appetite. Complements the /api/v1/fed-funds and other FRED macro endpoints. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The Crypto Fear & Greed index (0–100) with its rating, alongside the US stock Fear & Greed score for comparison, current BTC and ETH prices with 24h change, and ~90 days of crypto sentiment history. Pass `?days=N` to size the history. The crypto-sentiment companion to /api/v1/fear-greed (stocks). From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The current US stock-market Fear & Greed index (0–100, CNN-style) with its sentiment rating and all five weighted components — volatility, momentum, put/call, safe-haven demand, junk-bond demand — each with value, weight, and reading. Includes the last 30 days of scores and a backtest of S&P 500 forward returns by sentiment zone. A one-call read of market mood. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Current and resolved US drug shortages from openFDA, newest update first. Optional `?company=Pfizer` narrows to one manufacturer (omit for market-wide); `?limit=` (max 100). Each carries the generic name, company, status, therapeutic category, dosage form, presentation, posting/update dates, and reason. A supply-side catalyst for generic makers. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: FDA catalysts for a pharma/biotech/medtech company, from openFDA. Pass `?company=Medtronic` (required) plus `?limit=` (max 50). Returns `drug` (recalls + approvals) and `device` (510(k) clearances, PMA approvals, recalls) sections, each with recent items, match totals, and official FDA links. One call across 5 FDA datasets. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Timeline of corporate events for a ticker, such as ticker symbol changes, with the company name, CIK, and composite FIGI. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API for AI agents. No API key or account; pay in USDC via x402.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Settlement fails-to-deliver for a US-listed stock from the SEC's semi-monthly data: the aggregate shares that failed to deliver on each settlement date, with the reference price, most recent first. A niche short-pressure and squeeze signal. ?limit= records (default 30). Sourced from SEC EDGAR. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API. Pay per request in USDC via x402, no API key.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Reference list of US equity exchanges and market centers with names, MICs, operating MICs, and SIP participant IDs. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API for AI agents. No API key or account; pay in USDC via x402.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Historical cash dividends for a ticker: amount, currency, type, frequency, and the declaration / ex-dividend / record / pay dates. Most recent first. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API for AI agents. No API key or account; pay in USDC via x402.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Official US Treasury reporting rates of exchange — government FX reference rates for ~170 currencies, in units of foreign currency per 1 USD, for the latest quarter. Use for accounting-grade and exotic-currency conversion the market /api/v1/forex feed lacks. Filter with `?currency=Euro`. Updated quarterly. From the US Treasury (FiscalData). From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Price history for one energy benchmark — `wti` (WTI crude, $/bbl), `brent` (Brent crude, $/bbl), `natural-gas` (Henry Hub, $/MMBtu), or `gasoline` (US regular retail, $/gal) — with the latest value, prior reading, change, and recent history. Tune with `?limit=` (default 30, max 365). The catalog's commodities feed. Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA). From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Every energy benchmark in one call: WTI and Brent crude oil spot, Henry Hub natural gas spot, and US regular retail gasoline — each with its latest price, prior reading, and change. The catalog's commodities feed (no equity/forex/crypto endpoint carries these). For one benchmark with history use /api/v1/energy/{product}. Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA). From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: A company's recent SEC disclosure picture in one call: the filings index, insider transactions from Form 4 with a net buy/sell signal, material 8-K events by item code, and initial holdings from Form 3. The CIK is resolved once and shared across sections (faster than four separate calls), at a lower combined price. From SEC EDGAR; sections degrade independently. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Market-wide dividend calendar (no ticker needed). Per row: ticker, ex-dividend / record / pay / declaration dates, cash amount per share, currency, type, payments-per-year `frequency` + `frequency_label` (quarterly, monthly, weekly, one-time), and computed `annualized_amount`. Upcoming payments first. Filter `?from=`/`?to=` on ex-date, `?ticker=`, `?frequency=`, `?order=`, `?limit=`.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The official UTC open and close price for a crypto spot pair on a given date. Pass the pair in the path as BASE-QUOTE, e.g. BTC-USD, and the date via `?date=YYYY-MM-DD` (required). Crypto trades 24/7, so this is the UTC-day open/close. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API for AI agents. No API key or account; pay in USDC via x402.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Crypto trades 24/7, so there is no session close: this returns the previous UTC calendar day's full OHLCV candle (00:00–24:00 UTC) for a spot pair — open, high, low, close, volume, and VWAP. Pass the pair in the path as BASE-QUOTE, e.g. BTC-USD. One call returns yesterday's daily bar. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API. Pay per request in USDC via x402, no API key.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Historical OHLCV bars for a major-coin crypto spot pair at the requested multiplier and timespan (minute, hour, day, week, month) between `from` and `to`. Pass the pair in the path as BASE-QUOTE, e.g. BTC-USD or ETH-USD. Aggregated centralized-market spot — for Hyperliquid-listed token spot use /api/v1/spot, for perps use /api/v1/perps. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: CFTC Commitments of Traders for one futures market by slug: sp500, nasdaq, gold, silver, crude-oil, natural-gas, euro, british-pound, japanese-yen, swiss-franc, us-dollar-index, 10y-note, bitcoin. Returns open interest and non-commercial, commercial, and non-reportable long/short/net with weekly changes plus net history. `?weeks=` 12 (max 52). From the US CFTC. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The weekly CFTC Commitments of Traders positioning across major futures markets in one call: for each market the open interest, non-commercial (large speculator) net position and weekly change, and commercial (hedger) net position. Covers equity indices, gold/silver, crude/natural gas, major FX, the 10-year note, and bitcoin. No ticker needed. Sourced from the US CFTC. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Reference catalog of trade/quote condition codes (the numeric `conditions` seen on trades) with names, types, data types, and SIP mappings. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API for AI agents. No API key or account; pay in USDC via x402.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Recent stock trades disclosed by US members of Congress under the STOCK Act, parsed live from official House and Senate Periodic Transaction Reports: per trade the member, chamber, ticker, asset, buy/sell type, date, and disclosed dollar range. ?chamber=house|senate|both, ?ticker=AAPL, ?limit= recent filings per chamber (max 20). From US House & Senate. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The reported time series of one XBRL financial concept (e.g. Revenues, Assets, NetIncomeLoss) for a company, taken directly from its SEC filings. Pass the tag via `?tag=` and optionally `?taxonomy=` (default us-gaap) and `?limit=`. Each point carries the value, period, fiscal year/quarter, source form, and accession. Use for precise, filing-grade fundamentals and quant time series. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Compare 2 to 3 US-listed stocks side by side (peer or watchlist comparisons). Pass a comma-separated list via `?tickers=AAPL,MSFT,NVDA` (1 to 3 symbols). Returns price and day change, market cap, P/E, EPS, revenue, gross and net margins, and dividend yield per ticker. Built for multiple stocks — for a single stock, `/api/v1/quote/{ticker}` is cheaper. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Every XBRL financial fact a company has reported to the SEC, each collapsed to its latest value: tag, taxonomy, label, unit, the figure, and the period/form/filing it came from. Filter with `?taxonomy=us-gaap|dei`, `?search=revenue`, and `?limit=`. Discover which metrics exist for a ticker before drilling into the full series via /concept. Sourced from SEC EDGAR. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: One stock priced on every rail at once: its official US listing (delayed, closed overnight) against the 24/7 Hyperliquid HIP-3 synthetic perp. Returns both prices, funding APR, open interest, and the gap as `basis_percent` + `basis_vs_prev_close_percent` — while the US market is shut, the live view of where the name reopens. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Clinical trials run by a company, from ClinicalTrials.gov, newest first. Pass `?sponsor=Vertex Pharmaceuticals` (required) plus `?limit=` (max 100). Each trial carries NCT id, title, status, phase(s), study type, conditions, enrollment, lead sponsor, and start/completion/update dates with a link. A primary biotech catalyst. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Schedule 13D/13G filings — triggered when a holder crosses 5% of a class — disclosing beneficial-ownership and activist stakes in a US-listed company, from SEC EDGAR. Per filing: the reporting person, filer-reported percent of class (can be <5% if held via derivatives), shares, voting/dispositive power, and (for 13D) the activist intent. `?type=13D|13G|all`, `?limit=` max 25. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The full FOMC meeting schedule (2025–2027) with the last and next meeting and days-until. Each entry carries the two-day meeting's start and decision date, year, and past/upcoming status. No ticker needed — the rate-decision calendar every macro-aware agent plans around. Source: U.S. Federal Reserve. From x402stock, a market & economic data API (x402, USDC).

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Upcoming US economic data releases — WHEN the market-moving prints land, not just their latest values. Returns curated high-importance releases (CPI, PPI, PCE, jobs, JOLTS, GDP, retail sales, housing starts, industrial production) within `?days=` (default 30, max 90), each with date and category, plus the next FOMC meeting. `?past=true` includes the last week. Release dates from FRED.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Scans every US stock that also trades as a 24/7 synthetic perp and returns the gap: official (delayed) price, prev close, perp mark and oracle, funding APR, open interest, and computed `basis_percent` + `basis_vs_prev_close_percent` — the implied overnight move while the US market is shut. Widest dislocation first, plus a plain-English `reading`. `?limit=`, `?min_basis=`. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Use to discover the point-in-time archive: immutable daily snapshots of ephemeral market state (Hyperliquid perps/spot, JLP pool, pre-IPO marks, market regime, squeeze scores), captured once per UTC day and never overwritten or backfilled. Lists every feed and entity with date coverage; read days via /archive/{feed} and series via /archive/{feed}/range. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The stock price history endpoint. Returns historical OHLCV bars at the requested multiplier and timespan (minute, hour, day, week, month) between `from` and `to`. Use for price history, charting, backtesting, and trend analysis over any date range. From x402stock, a pay-per-call market & economic data API for AI agents. No API key or account; pay in USDC via x402.

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Use to read one immutable archived day of a feed (sol.jlp, hl.perps, prestocks.markets, scores.squeeze, …): the exact payload the live endpoint returned that day, plus provenance (observed/captured/ingested timestamps + a content hash proving contemporaneous capture). Defaults to latest; ?date=YYYY-MM-DD for a past day, ?entity= on multi-entity feeds. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Backtests a simple rule on a US stock and returns a finished report PNG. Runs an SMA crossover (?strategy=sma_cross&fast=50&slow=200) or RSI mean-reversion (?strategy=rsi_reversion&period=14&lower=30&upper=70) over daily history (?years=, max 5), no lookahead, rendered as an equity curve vs buy & hold. Returns full stats plus a hosted `artifact.png_url`. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: Use for time-series questions over the archive: how JLP AUM, Hyperliquid funding, a pre-IPO token premium, or a ticker's squeeze score evolved day by day. Per-day summaries (oldest first, ?from ?to ?limit, max 366) with capture provenance; payloads omitted — buy a full day via /archive/{feed}?date=. History accumulates daily and cannot be reconstructed retroactively. From x402stock

endpoints.name: x402stock
endpoints.description: The average interest rate the US Treasury currently pays on its outstanding debt, broken out by security (Treasury Bills, Notes, Bonds, TIPS, FRNs, savings, and the marketable/total aggregates) for the latest reported month, in percent. No ticker needed. A read on the government's cost of borrowing that complements the /treasury-yields curve. Sourced from the US Treasury (FiscalData).
